base_estimate: a loop runs 4 times per LED (~25,848 cycles): precompute per-item data in update(), skip items far from the LED early, or cut the count (line 85) — saves up to ~12,924 cycles/LED (~40.4 ms at 500 LEDs)
15 int/fixed↔float conversions per LED (~318 cycles each): keep a value in one type end to end (all-fixed maths, fixed() context reads) — saves up to ~2,862 cycles/LED (~8.9 ms at 500 LEDs)

float hsv2rgb() per LED (~1,311 cycles each): pass three args of the same fixed type (hsv2rgb(h, fixed(0.9), fixed(1.0))) for the integer path and return it from shade(), or precompute a colour table (line 79) — saves up to ~942 cycles/LED (~2.9 ms at 500 LEDs)
